name: Velocentra AI Logistics
author: bedebanks

sections.description:
Velocentra AI Logistics is a modern logistics and delivery management plugin for WordPress. It helps delivery businesses, dispatch teams, courier companies, and local service providers manage pickup requests, riders, customers, delivery statuses, tracking, notifications, and operational activity from one organized dashboard.

The plugin is designed for businesses that need a practical logistics workflow inside WordPress without depending on complex external software. It brings together request intake, rider coordination, customer tracking, delivery updates, proof of delivery workflows, analytics, and settings in a clean admin experience.

Velocentra AI Logistics is useful for courier services, last-mile delivery providers, dispatch startups, retail delivery teams, pharmacy delivery services, grocery delivery businesses, internal logistics teams, and growing service companies that need better visibility over delivery operations.

What You Can Do With Velocentra AI Logistics

  • Receive pickup and delivery requests from the frontend.
  • Manage pickup requests from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Assign and monitor riders.
  • Track delivery statuses.
  • Provide customers with a tracking page.
  • Manage riders, customers, branches, and zones.
  • View delivery analytics and operational summaries.
  • Send delivery workflow notifications.
  • Manage proof of delivery information.
  • Configure pricing, payment modes, appearance, notifications, and tracking options.
  • Display frontend portals through shortcodes.
  • Automatically create required frontend pages during activation.

Frontend Delivery Pages

Velocentra AI Logistics can automatically create the essential frontend pages required for customer and rider workflows. These pages help site visitors submit pickup requests, track deliveries, access customer delivery information, and allow riders to interact with assigned delivery workflows.

The plugin checks for required pages during activation and avoids duplicate page creation by detecting existing pages and shortcodes before creating missing pages again.

Delivery Request Management

The request dashboard helps administrators review pickup requests, customer details, delivery addresses, package details, payment mode, request status, rider assignment, and operational notes.

This gives delivery teams a central place to process new requests and follow deliveries from submission to completion.

Rider Management

Velocentra AI Logistics includes rider management tools for keeping rider records organized. Administrators can manage rider information, availability, assignment workflows, and delivery activity from the dashboard.

Customer Tracking

Customers can track deliveries using a tracking code. The tracking page provides a simple delivery visibility experience so customers can follow delivery progress without contacting support for every update.

Analytics and Reporting

The analytics dashboard provides useful operational visibility into request activity, delivery performance, rider activity, and logistics trends. This helps administrators understand how delivery operations are performing and identify areas that need attention.

Settings and Configuration

The settings area includes options for pricing, payment modes, rider settings, tracking settings, appearance settings, AI assistant settings, notifications, and frontend shortcode visibility. The settings are designed to be practical, organized, and easy to understand.

Shortcodes

Velocentra AI Logistics includes frontend shortcodes for adding logistics functionality to WordPress pages. A Shortcodes section inside the settings area displays the available shortcodes in neat cards with copy options.

WordPress.org Package

This WordPress.org package is a standalone logistics and delivery management plugin. It is fully functional as distributed and does not require a license key, trial period, quota unlock, or paid activation to use its included features.

About Velocentra Logistics Pro

A separate Pro plugin is available outside WordPress.org for businesses that need additional advanced logistics tools.

Pro features may include:

  • WooCommerce delivery integration.
  • Advanced dispatch automation.
  • Delivery scheduling and checkout delivery preferences.
  • Advanced analytics and operational intelligence.
  • GPS rider intelligence.
  • Smart rider suggestions.
  • Advanced customer communication workflows.
  • Branch-aware request flows.
  • Enhanced proof of delivery tools.
  • Enterprise workflow controls.

The Pro plugin is separate from this WordPress.org package. The free plugin remains fully functional and does not include locked local features.

Learn more about the separate Pro plugin:
https://plugins.entitude.com/plugins/velocentra-ai-logistics

External Services

This plugin may optionally connect to third-party services only when the related settings are configured by the site administrator.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/velocentra-ai-logistics directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Velocentra AI Logistics from the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Review the automatically created frontend pages.
  5. Configure pricing, riders, tracking, notifications, appearance, and other available settings.
  6. Add or review shortcodes from the Shortcodes section inside Settings.
sections.faq:
Is Velocentra AI Logistics free to use?

Yes. The WordPress.org package is fully functional as distributed and does not require a license key, paid activation, trial unlock, or quota unlock to use the included features.

Does the plugin create frontend pages automatically?

Yes. During activation, the plugin can create the required frontend pages for pickup requests, delivery tracking, customer access, and rider access. It checks for existing pages before creating new ones to avoid duplicates.

Can customers submit pickup requests from the frontend?

Yes. The plugin includes frontend request functionality that allows customers to submit pickup and delivery request information.

Can customers track deliveries?

Yes. Customers can use a tracking code to view delivery progress through the tracking page.

Can I manage riders?

Yes. The plugin includes rider management tools in the WordPress dashboard.

Does Velocentra AI Logistics include analytics?

Yes. The dashboard includes analytics and operational summaries to help administrators understand request activity, rider activity, and delivery workflow performance.

Does the plugin support shortcodes?

Yes. The plugin includes shortcodes for frontend logistics pages. You can view the available shortcodes from the Shortcodes section inside Settings.

Does this plugin work with WooCommerce?

WooCommerce delivery integration is available through a separate Pro plugin. The WordPress.org package remains fully functional without WooCommerce integration.

Is there a Pro plugin?

Yes. A separate Pro plugin is available for advanced logistics needs such as WooCommerce integration, advanced analytics, delivery scheduling, GPS rider intelligence, and expanded automation.

Will the free plugin stop working if I do not use Pro?

No. The WordPress.org package is standalone and remains fully functional for the features included in it.

Is the plugin translation ready?

Yes. The plugin uses WordPress internationalization functions and includes a text domain for translation support.

What PHP version is required?

The plugin requires PHP 7.4 or higher.

Is the plugin compatible with WordPress 7.0?

Yes. The plugin metadata declares compatibility with WordPress 7.0.
